Outcome: Reference and PostgreSQL catalogs support durable organizational records and controlled administration.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Add checked migrations and application contracts for labs/projects, membership, project dataset placement and human-readable metadata; preserve existing release IDs and attribution.
2. Migrate old curator/dataset records explicitly and provide audited stewardship transfer; no default public workspace or accidental access widening.
3. Prove reference/PostgreSQL agreement, concurrent updates, authorized administration, upgrade preservation and denial of unauthorized membership changes.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
